description: Runtipi is a homeserver for everyone! One command setup, one click installs for your favorites self-hosted apps. ✨

sources.entry: Tipi - Homeserver manager. One command setup, one click installs for your favorites self-hosted apps. (Source Code) GPL-3.0 Shell

summary.one_liner: Runtipi is a Docker-based personal homeserver orchestrator with a web interface for installing and managing self-hosted apps on a single server.
summary.what_it_does: Runtipi is described as a personal homeserver orchestrator for running multiple services on one server. It is based on Docker and provides a web interface to add and manage services. Apps are installed from an App Store repo, and the README says community app stores can also be added, and users can create their own. The README says it is designed so users do not need manual configuration or networking work. Installation is done via a single command, according to the repository description. The README points to runtipi.io for installation instructions, documentation, and guides, and offers a demo instance at demo.runtipi.io. It also describes the project as built with TypeScript, NestJS and React.
use_cases: run multiple self-hosted services on one home server
install self-hosted apps with one click
manage Docker-based services through a web interface
set up a home server without manual networking
add community or custom app stores
how_to_run: Install Runtipi on your server with the one-command setup described on the website
notable: One-command install and one-click app installs via a web interface
Built on Docker with apps sourced from an App Store repo
Supports community app stores and custom app stores
caveats: Built and maintained by volunteers with no guarantee of support or security
Described as stable but still in active development and may contain bugs
